text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
—Noooo!
I don't wanna go home yet~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"On the way back from an outing with Sweep Tosho,
we ran into a bit of a predicament..."
choice_data_list: Still, I have to head back now...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Why?! It's not even nighttime yet!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I wanna go farther away, and I wanna eat sweet things!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Witching hour is just getting started!
There's no way I'm going home!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...While I'm glad she seems to have enjoyed the outing,
we must head back soon, or it will interfere
with her schedule later today.

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha...! Come on,
try and catch me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right then, I happened to notice...
some kids playing with all their might,
as if getting in one last game before heading home.
choice_data_list: Alright, let's play to our heart's content!
Let's go through that magic circle!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph!
You should've just said so from the start!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Then by train—
choice_data_list: I'll go call out to them.
I'll go talk to them, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Haaah?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We asked the children if we could join in, and they happily agreed,
which was great and all, but...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No way!
I'm not interested in childish games!

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text:
Is that big sis not coming~?
Then let's keep playing tag!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Mmh, mmh, mmmgh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seems to be getting increasingly displeased.
As I wonder what I can do to help her enjoy herself...

text_block_list.name: Child B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, could you snap this branch off for me?
I'm gonna make it into a sword.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Making a sword... Maybe Sweepy would
play with me then!
choice_data_list: Looks like we're gonna need some magic here...
Looks like we'll need some magic here...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
!
Did you just say magic?

text_block_list.name: Child B
text_block_list.text: "No, I just wanted you to snap it normally using your grown-up strength."
choice_data_list: Ah... Ah! Just the witch I was looking for!

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Can that girl over there...
use magic?

text_block_list.name: Child C
text_block_list.text:
Ehhー! Amazing~!
I wanna see! Show me~!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
choice_data_list: I wonder if Sweep will cast her magic on me?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Geez!
You really leave me no choice♪♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: —Powerful☆Dimorphotheca!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CRACK!)

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Wow, now I have two swords~!
How did it split so cleanly!?
It really is like magic...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: It really is magic, I'm telling you! I looked for the weakest point and concentrated magical power right there!
choice_data_list: (It felt more like hand strength than magic, though...)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Here, this is a sword imbued with special magic. Take good care of it!

text_block_list.name: Child B
text_block_list.text: Um... yeah, thank you...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, Sweep Tosho, now in high spirits, joined in to play with the children... and as a result!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: —I'm tired, I'm going home!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: A magic circle?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Um,
do we go "hop, hop, jump"... like that, Maru?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Where Sweep Tosho pointed,
a long trail of circles
drawn by children stretched out."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's just something a kid wrote.
It doesn't have any power whatsoever.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...What?
choice_data_list: The witch of this land is the one who drew that magic circle.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hey, tell me more about that!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I explained that those circles were imbued with mana,
forming magic crests that granted more power
the further one traversed across them.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Rrrrreally?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Seems all we can do is try it.
What are the steps?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Hop, hop, hop...)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Amazing!
Magic power is overflowing...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that's really a magic circle, isn't it...!
Amazing, amazing!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's not actually a magic circle, of course...
Maybe it was a placebo effect, but
it seemed to have put her in a fun mood.
choice_data_list: (After this, just head straight to the academy...)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
My strength is fading...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...I figured it out!
This magic circle was still incomplete, wasn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, familiar, do something about this!
The effect is going to wear off!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hurry up!
Hurry up pleeease!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
—Got it, next is that white spot, right?
Here I go—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, by getting creative—like telling her the white stripes of the crosswalk were the continuation of a magic circle—I successfully managed to bring her home.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, it cut off!
Where's the next magic circle~?!
